claims.text: A machine-learning approach can accurately predict melting temperatures across the high-entropy-alloy family.
A machine-learning approach can accurately predict enthalpies of fusion across the high-entropy-alloy family.
A machine-learning approach can accurately predict entropies of fusion across the high-entropy-alloy family.
A machine-learning approach can accurately predict volume changes at melting across the high-entropy-alloy family.
A machine-learning approach can accurately predict liquid-phase thermodynamic properties across the high-entropy-alloy family.
The proposed machine-learning approach can determine these properties efficiently.
High-entropy-alloy thermodynamic properties have learnable relationships with composition and microstructure.
Machine-learning algorithms can identify patterns linking composition and microstructure to thermodynamic properties.
Identifying these patterns enables accurate prediction across the high-entropy-alloy family.
Prior methods for determining high-entropy-alloy thermodynamic properties are inaccurate or inefficient.
The performance of the approach is limited by the quality of its training data.
The performance of the approach is limited by the quantity of its training data.
The complexity of the relationships among composition, microstructure, and thermodynamic properties limits the approach.
Agreement between predicted properties and experimental measurements can be used to validate the approach.
A significant deviation between predictions and experiments would falsify the approach.
